---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Summary

A one-sentence description of what you're proposing.

## Problem this solves

What limitation or gap does this address? Why is it needed?

## Proposed solution

How do you envision this working? Be as specific as you can.

## Framework / combination context

Which framework(s) would this apply to?
- [ ] Vite
- [ ] TanStack Router
- [ ] Next.js App Router
- [ ] Next.js Pages Router
- [ ] CRA
- [ ] Astro
- [ ] All frameworks
- [ ] CLI / scaffold system

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered any other approaches? Why is this the better solution?

## Additional context

Screenshots, code examples, links to similar implementations in other projects — anything that helps make the case.

## Would you be willing to implement this?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to open a PR
- [ ] I'd contribute but would need guidance
- [ ] No, just suggesting
